Container.Name: ddns-agent
Container.Overview: DDNS Agent is a lightweight, modern Dynamic DNS updater with an integrated web panel. It supports 50+ DNS providers and features a management interface with real-time log streaming, webhook notifications, and automatic IP change detection. Initial login: admin with the instance password from /data/bootstrap-password; a password change is required. Persistent file logging: /data/logs/agent.log (rotates daily to agent-YYYY-MM-DD.log; archive retention configurable in Settings).
Container.Description: DDNS Agent - Lightweight Dynamic DNS Updater with Web Panel. Initial credentials: admin with the password from /data/bootstrap-password. Supports 50+ providers including Cloudflare, DuckDNS, GoDaddy, Hetzner, Namecheap, and more. Features: Real-time logs, webhook notifications, IPv4/IPv6, encrypted credentials, auto-backup. Writes /data/logs/agent.log with daily rotation; log archive retention is configurable in Settings.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage: database, backups, encryption key, and /data/logs (agent.log)

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Optional signing secret, at least 32 bytes (persistent auto-generated key if empty)

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: AES-256 encryption key as 64 hex chars (auto-generated and saved to /data/.key if empty)

Config.Name: Application UID
Config.Description: Unprivileged app UID; entrypoint migrates the dedicated data directory ownership

Config.Name: Trusted proxy CIDRs
Config.Description: Comma-separated CIDRs of actual reverse proxies; leave empty for direct access
